policy_hub_description: Review the terms of service and rules governing privacy protection and data processing in the ProjectCollab application.
policy_hub_terms_description: Rules and terms of using the ProjectCollab platform, user rights and responsibilities, and technical requirements.
policy_hub_privacy_description: Information about processing and protection of personal data, purposes of collection, and your rights.
policy_terms_sec1_intro: For the purposes of these Terms of Service, the following definitions apply:
policy_terms_sec1_def_projectcollab: – a web application developed as an educational project within the thesis entitled "PROJECT MANAGEMENT PLATFORM WITH AGILE METHODOLOGY INTEGRATION".
policy_terms_sec1_def_admin: – the individual who is the author and administrator of ProjectCollab.
policy_terms_sec1_def_user: – any individual using ProjectCollab within the scope provided by these Terms.
policy_terms_sec1_summary: These Terms of Service define the rules for using ProjectCollab as an educational project carried out as part of a diploma thesis.
policy_terms_sec2_p1: ProjectCollab has a demonstration, testing, and educational character.
policy_terms_sec2_p2: ProjectCollab is not intended for production use and does not guarantee uninterrupted operation, availability, or correctness of presented data.
policy_terms_sec3_p1: Access to ProjectCollab is available after creating a user account or via third-party authentication providers (Google, Microsoft). Using ProjectCollab takes place in accordance with its educational and testing purpose.
policy_terms_sec3_p2: The Administrator reserves the right to restrict or revoke access to ProjectCollab at any time.
policy_terms_sec4_p1: The user is obliged to use ProjectCollab in accordance with its intended purpose, solely for testing and educational purposes. Any activities contrary to this purpose are prohibited.
policy_terms_sec4_p2: Taking actions that could disrupt the operation of ProjectCollab or compromise its integrity is prohibited.
policy_terms_sec5_intro: The Administrator is not liable for:
policy_terms_sec5_item1: interruptions in the operation of ProjectCollab,
policy_terms_sec5_item3: consequences of using ProjectCollab contrary to its intended purpose.
policy_terms_sec5_outro: Using ProjectCollab is solely at the user's own risk.
policy_terms_sec6_p1: The Administrator is not liable for the operation of third-party services with which ProjectCollab may integrate, nor for consequences resulting from the terms and conditions of those services.
policy_terms_sec7_p1: For matters not covered by these Terms of Service, relevant provisions of applicable general law shall apply.
policy_terms_footer: ProjectCollab Terms of Service – version as of December 14, 2025
policy_privacy_sec1_p1_before: This Privacy Policy defines the rules for processing personal data in the web application
policy_privacy_sec1_p1_thesis: which constitutes an educational project carried out as part of a diploma thesis entitled "PROJECT MANAGEMENT PLATFORM WITH AGILE METHODOLOGY INTEGRATION" (hereinafter: "ProjectCollab").
policy_privacy_sec1_p2: ProjectCollab is non-commercial, demonstrational, and educational. It does not constitute a service provided electronically within the meaning of applicable legal regulations and is not intended for production use.
policy_privacy_sec2_intro: Within the operation of ProjectCollab, the following categories of personal data may be processed:
policy_privacy_sec2_item4: user identifiers from third-party authentication providers (Google, Microsoft),
policy_privacy_sec2_item5: OAuth tokens enabling access to the user's external services, in particular calendars.
policy_privacy_sec2_ip_info: The user's IP address may be processed within standard server logs for technical and security purposes, but it is not persisted in the ProjectCollab database.
policy_privacy_sec3_intro: Personal data is processed exclusively for the following purposes:
policy_privacy_sec3_item1: ensuring proper user registration and authentication,
policy_privacy_sec3_item2: executing local sign-in and sign-in via third-party identity providers (OAuth),
policy_privacy_sec3_item3: enabling integration of ProjectCollab with third-party services, particularly calendar services,
policy_privacy_sec3_item4: ensuring proper operation, integrity, and security of ProjectCollab,
policy_privacy_sec3_item5: fulfilling testing, demonstration, and educational objectives related to the diploma thesis.
policy_privacy_sec3_no_marketing: Personal data is not used for marketing, analytical, or profiling purposes.
policy_privacy_sec4_intro: The legal basis for processing personal data is:
policy_privacy_sec4_item1: user consent as referred to in Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR,
policy_privacy_sec4_item2: necessity of processing to deliver ProjectCollab functionality in accordance with Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
policy_privacy_sec5_intro: ProjectCollab uses authentication mechanisms provided by third parties:
policy_privacy_sec5_third_parties: Authentication and integration processes with these services take place in accordance with the terms and privacy policies of these entities. The Administrator has no influence over the scope and method of data processing by the specified providers.
policy_privacy_sec6_p1: ProjectCollab uses only technical cookies, including HTTP-Only cookies, necessary for the proper functioning of session and authentication mechanisms.
policy_privacy_sec6_p2: Additionally, ProjectCollab uses localStorage mechanisms exclusively to store user interface preferences. No passwords or authentication tokens are stored in localStorage.
policy_privacy_sec6_p3: ProjectCollab does not use analytical or marketing cookies. Any cookies originating from Google or Microsoft may be stored exclusively within their own login screens.
policy_privacy_sec7_p1: Personal data is stored only for the duration of the educational project or until deleted by the administrator.
policy_privacy_sec7_p2: Users do not have the ability to delete their account independently. Data deletion takes place upon user request or based on the administrator's decision.
policy_privacy_sec8_intro: The data subject has the right to:
policy_privacy_sec8_contact: To exercise the above rights, please contact the data administrator.
policy_privacy_sec9_p1: ProjectCollab is run exclusively in a local environment and is not publicly accessible on the Internet.
policy_privacy_sec10_p1: The Administrator reserves the right to amend this Privacy Policy in the event of functional changes to ProjectCollab or changes to applicable legal provisions.
policy_privacy_footer: ProjectCollab Privacy Policy – version as of December 14, 2025
